summary: Fixed the ledger package so all 755 unit tests pass and tools/audit.py reports no failed checks. Changes: round half away from zero, one leading minus in formatting, rate lookup that only looks back, header-over-dialect layout, reversals booked and valued at the original's date, and totals that sum per-entry rounded values. Also fixed the month_range import, fiscal quarter boundary, tax rule effective-date boundary, writer round-trip, and median rounding.
